Answer: B
Reason: The CT images demonstrate numerous thin-walled cysts distributed diffusely throughout both lungs with relative sparing of the costophrenic angles and apices, which is the characteristic radiographic pattern for lymphangioleiomyomatosis (LAM). This diffuse distribution distinguishes LAM from other cystic lung diseases like pulmonary Langerhans cell histiocytosis (which typically spares the bases) or emphysema.
